notes: UI mock and scaffold cases are auxiliary (TST-E2E-004): not G8, not API/DB/Provider coverage. expected_db/provider/observability are empty because no real DB or provider exists in this slice.

test_cases.preconditions: Throwaway fixture repo in os.tmpdir() with only allowed edges
expected_domain_postconditions: exit code 0 and an OK line
non-source files, .d.ts/.d.mts, and directories outside the scanned roots (apps/*/app, apps/*/src, apps/* top-level source files, packages/*/src; e.g. apps/web/scripts) are ignored

test_cases.preconditions: Real repository root (explicit --root and default root)
expected_domain_postconditions: exit code 0 and an OK line, no VIOLATION line
no WARNING lines

test_cases.preconditions: Fixture repo with presentation importing features / api-client impl / auth impl / mock
expected_domain_postconditions: exit code 1 and VIOLATION presentation-no-upward <file>:<line> <specifier>
ports, view-model types and domain imports are allowed

test_cases.preconditions: Fixture repo with features importing mock
expected_domain_postconditions: exit code 1 and VIOLATION features-no-mock <file>:<line> <specifier>
features -> presentation / port / provider is allowed

test_cases.preconditions: Fixture repo with imports written as template-literal dynamic import, import attributes, require(), import = require() and typeof import(); plus comments, strings and JSX text that merely look like imports
expected_domain_postconditions: exit code 1 and VIOLATION <rule> <file>:<line> <specifier> for every AST-recognised specifier form, line = the specifier line
comments, string literals and JSX text are never detected
an allowed edge written as a template-literal dynamic import is clean

test_cases.preconditions: Fixture repo with dynamic import() / require() whose argument cannot be resolved statically (interpolated template, identifier, process.env)
expected_domain_postconditions: WARNING unresolved-dynamic-import <file>:<line> is printed before the result line
an unresolved dynamic import is not a violation and does not change the exit code (0 with OK line)
with a real violation present the exit code is 1, the WARNING remains and no OK line is printed

test_cases.preconditions: Fixture repo with pnpm-workspace.yaml (LF and CRLF, comments, quoted entries, extra top-level keys), without the file (default apps/*, packages/*, tests), and with unsupported patterns; tests/package.json and tools/gen/package.json take part in the dependency graph
